Group Notes

Projects 1 October 2026

The STRONG Action officially begins

The Marie Skłodowska-Curie Staff Exchanges project STRONG, dedicated to investigating gravity in its most extreme regimes, kicks off on 1 October 2026. STRONG will bring together experts from around the world to advance theoretical and computational tools for modelling compact objects and their gravitational-wave emission. The project aims to probe strong-field gravity, characterise astrophysical environments, and explore possible extensions of general relativity and the Standard Model of particle physics, as well as new cosmological scenarios. Follow the action here!

Events 29 July 2026

The GSSI hosts the 2027 (first) LISA Consortium meeting

L’Aquila and the Gran Sasso Science Institute will organize the 2027 LISA Consortium meeting, from the 5th - 8th of July 2027. As the first meeting, since the reboot of the whole Consortium, it will be a great occasion to discuss and plan the Consortium work all together. Stay tuned for further news!
